reviews.title: Great Cooler, Amazing Price
reviews.comment: Cools great, install was easy enough for a large dual tower air cooler. Works great on both Intel and AMD CPUs. Nearly silent on low load. Probably the best value for money cooler.
reviews.author: Jessy

reviews.title: Great cooler for the price
reviews.comment: Great cooler for a great price. I have a Ryzen 5 7600X and the cooler works fantastic. My fans run quiet, so the idle temp is a little high at 50C, but under load it rarely ever goes above 80C, and has only just barely hit 90C when I was pre-loading several thousands chunks in Minecraft. It also sits a fair bit higher on the mobo, so my RAM still fit snugly under. Do be a little careful when mounting the fans, since the aluminum is quite thin.
reviews.author: Kenny L

reviews.title: You know ball if you buy this cooler
reviews.comment: If you know ball you know this is the best cooler to get for the money. This will cool extremely hot cpus (within reason) and your life will be awesome and your wallet will stay fat. Love this company have bought like 7 for them and never once had a complaint or issue

reviews.title: Feels a lot cheaper than the ak620 but it performs just as good!! Great value!
reviews.comment:
This was actually a really good value!
This performs just as good as the ak620 for half the price.  However the aluminum is much flimsier feeling, but the performance is just as good.
Since we can't buy deep cool anymore, and this was a great value, I would definitely buy again.
Easy to install.  No issues.
The included thermal paste sucks!!!  Make sure to get some mx-4 or something because the included paste is more like clay.  Completely solid.  I had no faith in the thermal paste so I used my trusted mx-4.  And all was great.
reviews.author: KenCamo

reviews.title: Best Air cooling for AMD RYZEN 5 9600X
reviews.comment:
I recently installed the Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 on my AMD Ryzen 5 9600X, and I have to say, I’m pretty impressed! Right out of the box, the cooler felt solid and well-made. The installation process was straightforward; all the brackets and hardware were included and clearly labeled, which made things a lot easier.
After getting it mounted, I was eager to see how it performed. During regular browsing and gaming sessions, I noticed that my CPU temps stayed impressively low. Even under heavier loads, like video rendering, the cooler handled everything without breaking a sweat. I’m used to hearing my previous cooler crank up the fan speed and make a racket, but the Peerless Assassin is surprisingly quiet. It’s great to have a cooler that keeps my system cool without sounding like a jet engine!
Visually, it fits nicely into my setup as well. The sleek design complements my build perfectly, adding a touch of flair without being over the top. Overall, I’m really happy with my purchase. If you’re building a mid-range system and want something reliable that won’t burn your wallet, I definitely recommend giving the Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 a try!
